_readme: دفعةُ رسوماتِ جيميناي — يقرؤُها سيرُ عمل n8n «شوجب — مولّد رسومات الأسئلة».
لماذا ملفٌّ في المستودعِ لا قائمةٌ داخلَ العقدة (قرارُ المالك ٢٠٢٦-٠٨-٢٧):
كانت الدفعةُ تُكتَبُ في كودِ العقدةِ نفسِها، فكلُّ دفعةٍ تكلّفُ ثلاثَ جولات:
تعديلُ العقدةِ ثمّ نشرُها ثمّ تشغيلُها. وصارت الدفعةُ الآنَ **دفعةَ git واحدة**
إلى فرعِ main ثمّ تشغيلٌ واحد — فسقطت خطوتانِ من كلِّ دورة.
الاستعمال:
١) حرّرْ items أدناه، وغيّرْ batchId إلى قيمةٍ جديدة.
٢) ادفعْ إلى main.
٣) شغّلِ السيرَ (execute_workflow) — يقرأُ هذا الملفَّ عبرَ واجهةِ GitHub.
٤) الصورُ تُودَعُ في فرعِ `graphics-inbox` تحتَ graphics-inbox/<name>.jpg
⚠️ batchId ليس زينةً: العقدةُ تُعيدُه مع كلِّ عنصر، فتتحقّقُ الجلسةُ أنّ
التشغيلَ قرأَ الدفعةَ الجديدةَ لا نسخةً مخزَّنةً في ذاكرةِ وسيط.
⚠️ والصورُ تُودَعُ في فرعٍ مستقلٍّ عمداً — كانت تُودَعُ في فرعِ العملِ فيُضطَرُّ
كلُّ إيداعٍ إلى دمجٍ يدويّ. والفرعُ المستقلُّ يُلغي ذلك.
شكلُ العنصر:
{ "name": "latin-slug", "subject": "وصفٌ إنجليزيٌّ للجسم" }
← يُبنى البرومبتُ حولَه بورقةِ المواصفاتِ البصرية.
{ "name": "...", "subject": "...", "face": true }
← أعضاءُ الحواسِّ: يُستبدَلُ قيدُ «بلا وجه» بقيدِ العضوِ المعزول.
{ "name": "...", "prompt": "برومبتٌ كاملٌ جاهز" }
← يتخطّى البناءَ كلَّه. يُستعمَلُ حينَ تُغري قائمةُ الهيكسات النموذجَ
برسمِ لوحةِ ألوانٍ داخلَ الصورة (وقعَ فعلاً مع رسمةِ العين).

items.name: butterfly-3region
items.prompt: Create a simple flat cartoon illustration of a butterfly for a children's coloring exercise, viewed from directly above with wings spread symmetrically. Use exactly THREE flat solid colors total, no more: (1) both wings must be the exact same single flat solid light-blue color with no pattern on them, (2) the body (head, thorax and abdomen combined into one simple elongated shape down the center) must be a single flat solid light-yellow color, (3) there must be exactly two small circular spots, one placed on each wing, both in the same single flat solid light-red color, simple plain circles with no pattern inside them. No gradients, no shading, no shadows, no texture, no decorative patterns anywhere else on the wings. A thin crisp black outline #111111 around every shape and around each inner part. Pure white background. No text, no labels, no facial features. One single standalone image only, square 1:1 aspect ratio.

items.name: sun-house-scene
items.prompt: Create a very simple flat cartoon illustration for a children's coloring and pointing exercise: a small house under a sun, made of exactly FOUR flat solid color regions total and no more. (1) A plain rectangular sky background filling the entire canvas edge to edge in one flat solid light-blue color. (2) A sun in the upper right area made of a circle with a few short triangular rays directly touching it, the circle and its rays must all be the exact same single flat solid yellow color so together they read as one connected shape. (3) A simple triangular roof in one flat solid dark-red color. (4) A simple rectangular wall/house-body directly below the roof (touching it with no gap and no overlap) in one flat solid beige color. Do not draw a door, windows, chimney, clouds, ground line, or any other element — only these four flat shapes. No gradients, no shading, no shadows, no texture. A thin crisp black outline #111111 around every shape. No text, no facial features. One single standalone image only, landscape aspect ratio close to 4:3.

items.name: ice-cream-2region
items.prompt: Create a simple flat cartoon illustration for a children's coloring exercise of a single-scoop ice cream cone, front view, made of exactly TWO flat solid color regions total. (1) A round scoop of ice cream on top in one flat solid light-pink color, perfectly plain with no swirl lines or texture. (2) A triangular waffle cone below it, directly touching the scoop with no gap, in one flat solid light-brown color, perfectly plain with no waffle grid pattern or lines. No gradients, no shading, no shadows, no texture, no sprinkles, no extra decoration. A thin crisp black outline #111111 around both shapes. Pure white background. No text, no facial features. One single standalone image only, square 1:1 aspect ratio.

items.name: ملف-صورة
items.prompt: Create an educational icon-style illustration for a children's app representing an 'image file': a simple rounded-rectangle document page with a small folded triangle at its top-right corner, and printed flat on the face of the page a small simple picture glyph of a mountain peak with a sun/circle above it (like a classic photo icon), rendered in the same flat colors as the rest of the page graphic. glossy cartoon vector illustration in a space-sticker style, bold saturated colors, each part shaded with a 3-4 step ramp of its own hue (highlight, base, shade, deep shade) as crisp discrete bands with hard edges and no soft blending, a broad white gloss highlight on curved surfaces, a thin crisp black outline #111111 with rounded caps around every part (a clean fine line, not a heavy border), plump rounded forms with no sharp angles, floating with no ground line and no cast shadow, absolutely no facial features on anything. No text, no letters, no numbers. One single standalone image only, square 1:1 aspect ratio, plain white background.

No real letters or numbers anywhere, only abstract line strokes. One single standalone image only, square 1:1 aspect ratio, plain white background.
